aka: 台杉投資管理顧問股份有限公司

funds.name: 台杉生技基金 (Taiwania Biotech Fund)
TaiAx Life Science Fund L.P. (with Tokyo-based Axil Capital)

strategy.thesis: Government-anchored (National Development Fund LP) growth-stage investment platform whose dedicated biotech fund line and newly launched cross-border TaiAx Life Science Fund (with Tokyo's Axil Capital) back later-stage Taiwanese and North American biopharma, medtech and digital-health companies, aiming to link them to international capital and next-generation drug development experience (e.g. gene therapy).

track_record.portfolio_count: 26 (across its two biotech funds, per 2023 reporting)

summary.en: Taiwan government-anchored investment platform (est. 2017) whose dedicated biotech fund (NT$5.9B) and new US$200M TaiAx Life Science Fund, co-formed with Japan's Axil Capital, target growth-stage biopharma, medtech and digital health companies in Taiwan and abroad.
summary.local: 台杉投資成立於2017年，旗下台杉生技基金（新台幣59億元）及與東京Axil Capital合資成立、目標2億美元的TaiAx生技基金，聚焦投資台灣及北美成長期生物製藥、醫材與數位醫療企業。

aka: 中華開發資本股份有限公司

funds.name: Healthcare Fund (中華開發生技基金)

strategy.thesis: Private-equity arm of China Development Financial Holding running a dedicated NT-dollar Healthcare Fund series (Fund I 2014, Fund II closed Dec 2020) that backs growth-stage / expansion-stage Taiwanese biotech, cell & gene therapy, medtech and digital-health companies, with over 60% of Fund II capital earmarked for Taiwan-related targets.

summary.en: Private-equity platform of China Development Financial Holding; its Healthcare Fund I (2014, NT$1.75B) and Healthcare Fund II (closed 2020, NT$3.11B) invest in growth-stage/expansion-stage biotech (incl. cell & gene therapy), medtech and digital-health companies, over 60% Taiwan-focused.
summary.local: 中華開發資本為開發金控旗下私募股權平台，其生技基金一期（2014年，新台幣17.5億元）與二期（2020年募集完成，新台幣31.1億元）鎖定成長期／擴張期的新藥（含細胞與基因治療）、醫材與數位醫療公司，逾六成資金投向台灣相關標的。

sources.title: CDIB launches second NT dollar-denominated healthcare fund
sources.supports: Healthcare Fund II size NT$3.11B, Fund I size NT$1.75B (2014), 60%+ Taiwan allocation, growth/expansion-stage strategy
sources.quote: mainly investing in young firms with high earnings growth and firms at the expansion stage with fair earnings growth; Healthcare Fund II ... size nearly double that of Healthcare Fund I which was established in 2014 with NT$1.75 billion; Over 60% of Healthcare Fund II's capital will be allocated to Taiwan-related targets.

sources.title: 我們的關係企業
sources.supports: existence of Healthcare Fund and Healthcare Fund II as active managed funds
sources.quote: CDIB Capital Management Consultants Co. Ltd., established in 2001 as the main equity fund management platform for CDIB Capital Group, currently manages equity funds including Healthcare Fund, Healthcare Fund II, Yida Healthcare (Kunshan) Fund, and other specialized investment funds.

verification_notes: CDIB Capital Group is a diversified private-equity manager (also does non-healthcare growth/buyout deals); this entry describes only its healthcare-dedicated fund line, which fits the growth/pre-IPO crossover slice.

funds.name: 安富大健康一號基金 (Anpu Big Health Fund No. 1)
安富大健康二號基金 (Anpu Big Health Fund No. 2)

strategy.thesis: Growth-stage private fund founded by biotech entrepreneur Lin Chun (also chairman of Quanfu Biotech / 台睿生技) that targets Series B/C Taiwanese biotech and 'big health' companies that have cleared early technical risk and entered clinical/commercial-scaling stages, en route to public listing.

summary.en: Taiwan growth-stage private fund (Anpu Big Health Fund No.1 2022 NT$1.5B, No.2 2023 targeting NT$3B) founded by biotech entrepreneur Lin Chun, backing Series B/C biotech and 'big health' companies such as Quanfu Biotech (listed 2023), Tairuei Biotech and Yiyun Medical.
summary.local: 由生技創業家林羣創立的成長期私募基金，安富大健康一號基金（2022年，新台幣15億元）與二號基金（2023年，實收達21.75億元）鎖定B輪、C輪台灣生技與大健康企業，投資案例包括2023年上市的全福生技、台睿生技與宜蘊醫療。

sources.title: 美時前董事長主導，小公司組成史上最強陣容！這檔生技股將是下一顆耀眼明星？
sources.supports: fund names, fund sizes NT$1.5B (Fund 1) and NT$2.175B paid-in (Fund 2 as of July 2024), founding years 2022/2023

sources.title: 安富資本、全福董事長林羣 制霸生技策略心法
sources.supports: founder Lin Chun's background and portfolio companies (台睿, 宜蘊, 先知, 先驅, 全福)

aka: 鑽石生技創業投資股份有限公司

funds.name: 併購發展基金 (M&A / Growth Development Fund, 8-10yr horizon)

size.raw: 逾新台幣100億元 (over NT$10 billion)

strategy.thesis: Taiwan's first publicly listed (TPEx/TWSE: 6901, listed Sept 2023) 'evergreen' biotech venture capital firm, founded 2013 by Sinphar Group (中天生技) and backed by Fubon, Taishin and Ruentex financial groups; post-IPO it raised over NT$10 billion for an 8-10 year M&A/growth-stage development fund to consolidate and scale Taiwan biotech companies toward exit, alongside earlier-stage biotech incubation from academic spinouts.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Sources biotech spinouts from partner universities/research institutes (Academia Sinica, NTU, NTHU, etc.) and also runs a listed-company M&A/growth fund.

summary.en: Taiwan's first exchange-listed 'evergreen' biotech VC (TPEx/TWSE: 6901; listed Sept 2023), founded 2013 by Sinphar Group with backing from Fubon/Taishin/Ruentex; raised over NT$10 billion post-IPO for an 8-10 year M&A/growth-stage fund to scale Taiwan biotech companies toward exit.
summary.local: 台灣首家掛牌上市的永續型生技創投（櫃買/證交所代號6901，2023年9月掛牌），由中天生技於2013年發起，富邦、台新、潤泰三大金融集團參與；上市後集資逾新台幣100億元成立8-10年期的併購發展基金，扶植台灣生技公司壯大並邁向出場。
